719-4125-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-4125-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-5434-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5434-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-3249-4549-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Relic of Legends's ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

728-6754-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1170-2829-5131-6595--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-6595--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

3291-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least two.
3291-4091-7791.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Karametra's Acolyte.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

457-1792-4404-7692.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-4404-7692.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Shuri.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2919-3490-7399.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-7399.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1863-2103-4423-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
1863-2103-4423-6886.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

339-677-3967-4927.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2734-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
2734-4222-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
2734-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

803-3129-3951-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
803-3129-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-2511-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-2511-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2281-4050-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior, adding one mana of any color.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

560-2034-4550-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2034-4550-4616.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1636-2034-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2034-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1174-1257-1846-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Walking Atlas.
You control at least two Islands that enters the battlefield untapped.
1174-1257-1846-4222.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a tapped Island to your hand, untapping another Island.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting an Island from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3458-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two aritfacts and/or enchantments.
914-3458-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R/G}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dockside Extortionist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Actviate Impromptu Raid by paying {2}{R/G}, revealing Dockside Extortionist from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

280-654-774.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1124-2696-2858-4074.description:
Activate Chandra, Torch of Defiance's second ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Chandra, Hope's Beacon's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

2179-3609-3933.notablePrerequisites: Magistate's Scepter has at least two charge counters on it.
2179-3609-3933.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

205-1350.description:
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Azor from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Azor by paying {2}{W}{W}{U}{U}.
Azor enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat each turn.

709-2232-4772-4852-4977.description:
Cast Tyvar by paying {2}{G}{G}, which enters with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tyvar's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Tyvar dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Tyvar ability, causing you to get an emblem.
Cast Elvish Mystic by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Elvish Mystic spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Elvish Mystic enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Fyndhorn Elves from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Elvish Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Fyndhorn Elves by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Fyndhorn Elves spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Fyndhorn Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Elvish Mystic from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Fyndhorn Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 5.

3263-3586-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Magus Lucea Kane.
Magus Lucea Kane does not have summoning sickness.
3263-3586-4222.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
You may then cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its mana cost, getting infinite copies of that spell or ability.

3470-3525-5196.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Murasa Rootgrazer.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Island.
3470-3525-5196.description:
Activate a basic Island you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning the Island from your battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting the Island from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Island enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

708-736-2459-5147.notablePrerequisites: Copy Enchantment is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-736-2459-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.
